name: Deuces
description: The Morgan Deuces are a Chicago street gang founded in 1959 in the Near West Side neighborhood at the intersection of Taylor Street and Morgan Street. Founded by Teddy McGee, a former Latin Count, the gang expanded into Pilsen and Marshall Square and spawned the Cullerton Deuces faction in the late 1960s. They aligned with the People Nation under the five-point star.
